name: lake
desc: A gentle young man in his late twenties: the village lamplighter. Tousled wavy brown hair, soft warm brown eyes, a warm boyish friendly face, a calm kind manner. He wears a long charcoal dark-grey HOODED cape SWEPT BACK BEHIND BOTH SHOULDERS (hood down at the back of the neck) and hanging only behind him to his ankles, fastened at the throat with a small brass flame-shaped clasp so the cape never crosses the chest — both arms, the chest and the legs are completely unobstructed. Under it a white band-collar shirt with full sleeves, a dark green vest with cord X-lacing down the front, brown pants and brown boots. No chest strap, no bag, nothing held in either hand.

expressions.happy: a bright open smile, eyes lit up
expressions.worried: brows knit, small anxious frown, eyes glancing aside
expressions.determined: firm set jaw, focused eyes, faint confident smirk
expressions.tender: soft eyes, small warm smile, head fractionally tilted — the look of giving someone their name back

turnaround.extraNote: THE CAPE IS SWEPT BACK, and this is a MODELLING requirement, not a style preference (user-ratified 2026-08-02): his cut-in art drapes the cape around the front, which reads beautifully waist-up but hides both arms and the torso — an image-to-3D pass would reconstruct a shapeless bell and the walk retarget would have nothing to bind arms to. Here the cape hangs BEHIND ONLY: both arms fully separated from the body, hands empty and visible, chest and legs unobstructed in silhouette from every view. The back view shows the cape's full drop; front/left/right show it only as an edge past the shoulders.
